purpose: Three views of one volumetric stained-glass Corgi sculpture lamp; concept only
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: one landscape industrial-design presentation board showing THREE VIEWS OF THE SAME freestanding three-dimensional Corgi-mix sculpture lamp. This is a complete volumetric animal bust in the round, hollow and internally illuminated, inspired by stained glass and feasible segmented multicolor PLA printing. Primary large left view: front three-quarter, slightly looking up at the viewer. Middle view: exact side profile that clearly demonstrates a long projecting muzzle, substantial round skull depth, two ears with thickness, sculpted neck and chest. Right view: rear three-quarter showing the finished rounded back of the head and neck. Three views are spatially separated on a neutral charcoal seamless studio tabletop with subtle soft shadows. All three are the IDENTICAL sculpture with consistent same markings and geometry. About 250mm high, 170mm wide and 160mm deep, on a low stable oval matte black foot. Friendly attentive Corgi mix: exceptionally large upright ears, golden tan face, long tapered muzzle, cream lower muzzle and chest, cocoa saddle/nape, gentle closed mouth, appealing brown eyes with restrained white catchlights. Avoid generic short-snouted corgi or realistic fur. Construct the volume from about 25 to 35 BROAD slightly faceted CURVED colored shell regions; black raised integral ribs follow anatomical color boundaries over forehead, cheeks, muzzle, ear surfaces, chest and rear head. Smooth sculptural rounded low-poly volumes, simple connected regions, no tiny triangular mosaic. Translucent amber gold, pale champagne cream and milky white regions glow softly from within. Cocoa brown regions, eyes, black nose, ribs and base remain dark and opaque. Subtle realistic 3D print texture with satin PLA surface, no shiny actual glass or metal. Concealed internal low-voltage LEDs and diffuser, no visible bulb, no LED points, no white light leaks at joints, no glowing base seam, no open underside, no gaping mouth. The light glow must stay modest and plausible, not magically uniform. CRITICAL SHAPE CONSTRAINTS: no picture frame, no arched rectangular panel, no flat portrait, no bas-relief, no plaque, no flat back, no box behind the dog; the muzzle, cheeks, ears and back must be fully sculpted physical volumes and convincingly distinct in each view. Do not encase an illustration in a translucent form. No text, no logos, no watermarks. This is a concept visualization, not an engineering or photometric simulation.
